remarks: ***Highest/Best Mon. 9/22 @ 12p.*** Not all streets are created equal & Lund Ave in Springdale proves it. This Springdale gem offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful suburban setting with shops, restaurants & Metro North train around the corner (NYC in under an hour), downtown Stamford in ~10 minutes & easy access to both the Merritt Pkwy & I-95 for perfect commuting. Set on a spacious corner lot with a generous front yard, setback & a fully fenced backyard, this updated ranch offers true one-floor living with a layout & lifestyle that make daily life easy & entertaining a joy. Step inside to freshly painted interiors, refinished hardwood floors, LED lighting & sunlight pouring through the bay window into the open-concept living & dining area. The kitchen, complete with peninsula seating, features butcherblock & granite countertops, multiple exits to the yard & easy access to the garage, perfect for entertaining & everyday convenience. The primary suite includes built-in closets & a renovated bath, the 2nd bedroom also has custom built-in closets, & the 3rd bedroom is partial en-suite to another updated full bath that is also accessible via the hallway. A one-car garage, newer mechanicals & move-in-ready updates throughout make this home a low-maintenance winner. Whether you're enjoying morning coffee on the porch, evenings on the back deck, or simply soaking up the curb appeal, this is the perfect Springdale lifestyle: suburban charm w/city convenience at your doorstep
